topic: Current toolchain (CN-TT v4 era). The pre-CN-TT piecemeal pipeline was archived 2026-06-11; this folder now holds only proper current tools.
purpose: Local bring-your-own-AI onboarding node. Orient any AI/agent on the current tooling, then hand back to the central chain.
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain relative to the Hs repo root.

byo_ai_onboarding.mission: Learn compositional analysis with Hs — a deterministic EXTENSION to standard CoDa — well enough to run it and read its outputs. Bring your own AI; this node + the chain teach it.
byo_ai_onboarding.the_one_idea: A composition carries only relative information; Hs reads its DYNAMICS in Aitchison log-ratio geometry, deterministically, with a hash receipt. 4 parts = an exact quaternion rotation; higher-D is tiled from overlapping exact 4-part charts and reconstructed losslessly.
byo_ai_onboarding.standard_coda_relation: Hs uses STANDARD CoDa tools (closure, CLR, ILR/Helmert, the Aitchison metric) and extends them into a deterministic monitoring instrument for machine and embedded applications. The mathematics is standard CoDa-compatible; the deterministic instrument is the new part.
byo_ai_onboarding.determinism_doctrine: Determinism is binding by doctrine AND practice: same input -> same output -> same content hash; no statistics in the science path. See ../../HUF/huf-gov/doctrine/.
byo_ai_onboarding.expert_decides: The instrument reads and hands you diagnostics + SS-CCC-LLL codes; the domain expert assigns meaning. Open-loop (Skydiver Doctrine).

specific_knowledge.what: One engine, one run path. The current general tool here is cntt_report.py — runs any composition CSV through CN-TT v4 and prints a diagnostics + SS-CCC-LLL code report (carrier-guard / E-21 aware); it composes the canonical runner + the code system and adds no new science. The archived primitive pipeline (hs_* 12-step, manifold/projector generators, old interactives, the quarantined transcendental pre-test) is at mirror-root _archive_2026-06-11/Hs-tools-primitive-pipeline/.
key_results: Tier 1: cntt_report.py verified on clean data and the E-21 all-zero case (surfaces GD-ZRC-CAL + SM-SZC-CAL).
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: Tier 1 = verified/computed; Tier 2 = standard math soundly applied / practiced doctrine; Tier 3 = to earn.

governance: Honest-broker; nulls reported straight; Peter is the sole commit/contact gate; AI-assisted per HUF-STD-001. The archived pipeline is reversible (moved, not deleted).
